name: citation-verification
description: Verify that every reference in a manuscript really exists and matches its metadata, catching hallucinated, corrupted, mismatched or retracted citations before submission. Use when checking a .bib file or reference list, after an AI assistant drafted citations, when a DOI may point to the wrong paper, when a paper may have been retracted, when a dataset or software DOI (Zenodo, DataCite) will not resolve, when adding missing DOIs, marking unverifiable references, checking whether one DOI is real,
author: KalarisLabs
